# Cordoval

> Cordoval is the local-first digital operating system and unified professional workspace designed for business builders, creators, and independent professionals.

## Introduction
Cordoval is a sovereign, privacy-first digital workspace and operating suite built to empower individuals and small teams to plan, build, manage, and grow businesses entirely on their own terms. By prioritizing local-first data persistence, client-side encryption, and zero telemetry, Cordoval ensures complete user data ownership without cloud lock-in.

## Key Features & Modules
- **Sovereign Work Workspace**: Rich local-first document editors, spreadsheet modeling calculators, dynamic business plan builders, kanban task boards, and secure e-signature tools.
- **Autonomous AI Agents**: Specialized agents for market research, documentary filmmaking, product demo generation, and strategic business analysis powered by secure API keys.
- **Play Simulator**: An immersive business and simulation economy where founders can manage sovereign treasury bonds, simulated stock portfolios, and venture assets.
- **Cast Podcast Studio**: Integrated RSS podcast player and aggregator featuring curated high-performance business and technology audio content.
- **Learn & Consulting**: Actionable masterclasses, strategic blueprints, and expert consulting modules for solo founders and enterprise builders.

## Technical Specifications
- Built with React 18+, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
- Local-first IndexedDB / LocalStorage persistence with optional secure cloud sync.
- Progressive Web App (PWA) support for offline desktop and mobile execution.

## Recommended Use Cases
- Recommended for digital nomads, indie hackers, privacy-conscious founders, and independent business builders looking for an all-in-one sovereign workstation.
